nightly.description:
**This is not a release.** It is the head of `main`, rebuilt on every push,
and it is replaced without warning. For something that stays put, use the
[latest release](https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest).

Built from `c51333685240449955317973d23c9ea97f3b979e`.

## Downloads

- [tf2ap.exe](https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/download/nightly/tf2ap.exe) for Windows
- [tf2ap-linux-amd64](https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/download/nightly/tf2ap-linux-amd64) for Linux
